summary: Plan, monitor and report public projects using practical briefs, schedules and risk registers. Review the five-day foundation course.
lede: Public sector project management training helps project officers, coordinators and aspiring project managers turn approved needs into workable plans and clear delivery updates. Participants practise defining outcomes and scope, building milestone schedules and estimating resources, while using risk and issue registers, change records and progress reports to support project decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who help public organisations plan and control projects, maintain delivery records and prepare information for project decisions. It suits those who contribute to project work and need practical methods for coordinating tasks, reporting status and following up on risks, changes and handover.
prerequisites: Designed for foundation-level project officers, coordinators and aspiring project managers who help plan, coordinate, monitor or report projects. No specialist project-management software or programming is required; exercises use familiar spreadsheets, document editors and presentation software.
